snippet.title: Final Call! Meow My Crop Final Beta Test Announcement
snippet.description:
📢 We are now launching the exclusive mission for the final beta test of Meow My Crop, recruiting all potential cat farmers across the internet!
⏰ Start Time: 9 PM, April 27th
✅ Entry Requirement: Add Meow My Crop to your Steam Wishlist
📥 How to Join: Enter the official community server. Game redemption codes will be distributed directly in the group; simply activate the code to start playing.
🎁 Exclusive Reward: Limited-edition beta-exclusive outfit set, which will never be reissued once missed.
Adorable kittens are eagerly waiting for you! See you at 9 PM on April 27th!
